test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements regarding end standard is incorrect?

options.text: The blades are subject to wear.
It is slower but more accurate.
It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.
It measures the distance between two parallel plane surfaces.

solution:
The correct answer is __It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines**(Option 3)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• End standard__ is a precision measuring instrument.
 
• It is primarily used to measure the distance between two parallel plane surfaces.
 
• The blades are subject to wear over time.
 
• It is slower compared to line standards but is more accurate.
 
• It does not measure the distance between two engraved lines on a surface.
 
• End standards are typically utilized in engineering metrology for high precision measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Line Standard:**

 
 
• It measures the distance between two engraved lines on a surface.
 
• It is less accurate compared to end standards.
 
 
 
• **Slip Gauges:**
 
 
• These are used in conjunction with end standards for precision measurement.
 
• Slip gauges are made of hardened steel or ceramic material.
